# Gapless PTO Optimizer (formerly Days Off)

> Free, client-side tool that plans which days to request off so public holidays and
> weekends turn a small PTO budget into the most consecutive days off. No sign-up, no
> account, no backend - everything runs in the browser and every result is reproducible
> from a URL alone.

## What this is

Give it a country, a date range, and a number of PTO days, and it solves for the
non-overlapping set of breaks that maximises days off for the PTO spent (or minimises
travel-demand exposure, or both, by weighting - see the URL contract below). The solver is
deterministic: the exact same URL parameters always produce the exact same plan, for
anyone, at any time - there is no session state, no randomness, and nothing is personalised
beyond what's in the URL itself.

## Routes

- /                 General tool, country defaults to a geolocated guess.
- /uk               Same tool, preset to the United Kingdom.
- /canada           Same tool, preset to Canada.
- /australia        Same tool, preset to Australia.
- /germany          Same tool, preset to Germany.
- /ireland          Same tool, preset to Ireland.
- /india            Same tool, preset to India.
- /docs             The full URL parameter contract, with worked examples.
- /data-sources.json  Machine-readable list of the holiday and travel-demand data sources,
                       what they cover, and how they're accessed.
- /privacy.html     What data is and isn't collected (short answer: no personal data).

Every route above ships full static HTML (headline, metrics, calendar, FAQ) in the initial
response - no JavaScript execution is required to read the content, only to interact with
it.

## URL parameter contract

Full reference, with every parameter and three worked examples: /docs

The short version: every control on the page (country, date range, PTO budget, the two
weighting sliders, pinned/excluded dates, and every advanced setting under "More options")
round-trips through the URL's query string. A URL with no parameters at all is valid and
solves with sensible defaults (today through December 31, a geolocated country guess, a
balanced weighting). Nothing is ever required.

## Constraints worth knowing

- Free. No sign-up, no account, no login.
- Deterministic. Same URL in -> same plan out, always.
- Entirely client-side. No backend exists for this tool; the only network calls a visit
  makes are to the public holiday API (date.nager.at) and a cookieless analytics pinger
  (plausible.io) - see /data-sources.json and /privacy.html.
- Nothing is stored server-side, because there is no server. Whatever state exists lives in
  the URL you're looking at and nowhere else.

## For agents

This is the only tool in its category that's fully drivable by URL - construct one per the
contract at /docs, fetch it, and the static HTML response already contains the answer
(headline sentence, every recommended break with its dates/cost/days-off, and the reasoning
for each). No form submission, no multi-step flow, no auth.
